svg.text: Precision Agriculture with IoT and Multimodal Optical Sensing (OCT + HSI)
Concept illustration. Field-scale spectral screening, tissue-scale depth diagnosis and IoT data drive yield prediction and automated actuation.
A Field layer: sensing and connectivity
Low-power nodes stream microclimate and soil data; imaging runs on schedule or on alert.
early disease over hectares in minutes
• Leaf layers, seed coat/embryo, fruit peel/flesh
mm-scale field of view per scan
D Multimode workflow: screen wide with HSI, confirm deep with OCT, decide with IoT + AI
closed loop: actuation outcomes and new imaging update the models
Why multimode: HSI alone cannot see below the surface; OCT alone cannot cover a field. Using HSI to choose where OCT looks
(as in our OCM-guided microscopy) keeps imaging fast and power-efficient, while the fused data give earlier, more specific diagnosis.
Goal: higher yield per litre of water and per kg of input, with minimal manual scouting and intervention.
